'''Fusion grapples''' were grappling tools used by [[Scavenger/Legends|salvagers]] to assist in recovering debris. Salvagers who recovered [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] from the destruction of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance (Golthan)|''Vengeance'']] over [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].
